compile.nuance: Defect option O-EPD-53874 ('Freddie Mac EPC Selection') is textually scoped to 'loans sold to Freddie Mac that are 60 days or more past due in the first six months,' but this card's route is FNM (Fannie Mae, per scope.route in the source) with applicability_sql=null (no SQL restricts it to a Freddie-only subset). This mirrors the taxonomy's base-data finding on Freddie-prefixed exception content surfacing on generic/FNM-scoped cards -- code prefix and exception-name investor references do not reliably signal true scope. Finding fields (exception_code/severity/description/aor) are carried verbatim per instructions; the applicability predicate is left as always:true since no source SQL exists to encode a narrower restriction. Downstream: confirm with Gordon whether this option applies only when the loan was sold to Freddie Mac (needs a context_flag/condition added) or is a mis-tagged general EPD-selection-methodology check.

notes: Only 1 of 7 total answer options carries an exception_code; the other 6 (COVID default cause, no observations, N/A, servicing notes, fraud escalation, first payment default) are free-text observation options with no exception_code and are excluded from defect_options.
